meta_doc_type_001.evidence: COLLECTIVE BARGAINING AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE WASHINGTON TEACHERS UNION... AND THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA PUBLIC SCHOOLS

meta_bargaining_unit_003.answer: Teachers, specifically ET and EG bargaining units
meta_bargaining_unit_003.evidence: DCPS recognizes the WTU as the sole and exclusive bargaining representative for the purpose of negotiating all matters related to rates of pay, wages, benefits, hours of employment, and working conditions for employees in the occupational bargaining units and job classifications defined in this article, and collectively referred to in this Agreement as “Teachers.”
